notes: Outflows are first-hop HBAR transfers from each wallet, classified by destination; sends to known deposit relays count as CEX.
Reaching a sell venue is not proof of a market sale: it can be market making, OTC settlement or treasury operations.
Labels marked medium/low confidence come from this repo's own forensics, not from Hedera.
USD values use the price above and are rough.

Hedera outflows are first-hop HBAR transfers sent by the project-controlled treasury accounts, classified by recipient (exchange list, DEX/wrapped HBAR, another treasury account, or unlabelled). Windows end at the settled day end 2026-11-16T00:00:00.000Z.

Treasury accounts that are not traced (they stay treasury for supply): 0.0.54 (Network administration account (about 100 HBAR): an estimated 5.6 million file-update records with no HBAR movement in 90 days (about 56,000 mirror pages, over the 20,000-page limit for one account), so it is not traced. Owner decision pending.) 0.0.98 (Network system account: its payouts are protocol rewards or fees, not project disbursements, so they are not traced.) 0.0.800 (Network system account: its payouts are protocol rewards or fees, not project disbursements, so they are not traced.) 0.0.801 (Network system account: its payouts are protocol rewards or fees, not project disbursements, so they are not traced.)
Onward hops from unlabelled recipients are not traced for Hedera. Wrapped HBAR (WHBAR) is counted as DEX with no look-through to its holders.
Fees are not flows, staking-reward legs are removed, and a failed transaction moves nothing but its fee. In a transaction with several senders and recipients, transfers are paired largest to largest.
23 registry treasury accounts hold no HBAR and sent nothing in the window; they are left out of the table.
